# Centers.pk - Complete Site Documentation for AI Agents

## Site Overview
- Name: Centers.pk
- URL: https://www.centers.pk
- Type: Free Online Tools Platform
- Languages: English (en), Urdu (ur), Hindi (hi), Arabic (ar)
- Tools: 53+ free tools in 7 categories
- Blog: 54 complete guides with tutorials

## Technical Details
- Framework: Next.js 14.2.35 (App Router)
- Database: SQLite (better-sqlite3)
- Hosting: Dokploy on VPS
- DNS: Cloudflare
- Sitemap: https://www.centers.pk/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.centers.pk/robots.txt

## Category Structure
1. Calculators (10 tools): age, bmi, loan, currency, date, percentage, tip, compound-interest, gpa, unit-converter
2. Code Tools (8 tools): base64, css-formatter, html-formatter, javascript-formatter, json-formatter, qr-code-generator, url-encoder, xml-formatter
3. Design Tools (1 tool): color-picker
4. Image Tools (9 tools): background-remover, favicon-generator, image-compressor, image-converter, image-cropper, image-filters, image-resizer, image-rotator, meme-generator, photo-collage
5. PDF Tools (4 tools): pdf-compressor, pdf-merger, pdf-splitter, pdf-to-word
6. Security Tools (10 tools): api-security, data-masking, encryption-tools, firewall-tester, hash-generator, password-generator, secure-file-wipe, security-analyzer, ssl-checker, two-factor-auth
7. Text Tools (11 tools): case-converter, character-counter, cv-builder, lorem-ipsum, markdown-editor, regex-tester, text-diff, text-extractor, uuid-generator, word-counter
